text: better-model-provider 是面向 DSH Web 的模型能力设置插件，会在设置侧栏注册“Model capabilities”页面，并通过现有设置与模型目录接口读取和保存配置。它允许逐模型编辑推理等级及发送给端点的 wire 拼写、输入模态、上下文窗口和最大输出 token；对官方目录模型只保存稀疏覆盖并可恢复官方默认值，也可编辑自定义模型列表。适合需要为不同模型分别声明能力或调整目录模型默认项的 DSH Web 用户。插件不负责创建服务商或配置 API Key，这些仍在官方 Models 页面管理。

better-model-provider adds a DSH Web page for per-model reasoning mappings, input modalities, context windows, and output limits. It edits custom lists and stores sparse, resettable overrides for catalog models. Provider setup and API keys stay on the official Models page.
我想给不同模型单独设置推理强度。
怎么修改某个模型支持的图片输入？
能不能只调整一个官方目录模型，而不改掉整份模型清单？
我需要把某个模型的上下文窗口和输出上限设成指定数值。
官方模型的能力覆盖改错了，怎样恢复原始设置？
想在 DSH 网页里查看并完善每个服务商的模型能力声明。
How can I give each model its own reasoning levels and wire values?
I want to override one installed model without replacing the provider's catalog list.
Can I set a model's context window and maximum output tokens in the web settings?
better-model-provider 的功能「逐模型推理等级」：为模型选择继承、关闭推理或自定义等级，并编辑各等级实际发送的 wire 拼写。展开模型行后在推理编辑器中操作，应用前会校验等级及拼写。
better-model-provider 的功能「输入模态设置」：按模型选择允许的输入模态，例如 image。展开模型行并勾选模态，应用时校验值来自当前 schema 声明的选项，再写入该模型配置。
better-model-provider 的功能「上下文与输出容量」：逐模型填写 context window 和 max output tokens，支持 K/M 写法；留空继承默认值。
better-model-provider 的功能「官方目录覆盖」：点击 Manage official models 后编辑目录模型；只保存改动字段，其他默认值继续继承，也可重置单个模型。
better-model-provider 的功能「编辑自定义模型与引导目录服务商」：用户拥有模型列表时直接修改列表中的模型能力；未配置的官方目录服务商可从折叠区域展开，首次应用覆盖后创建配置。
better-model-provider 使用前须知：服务商配置和 API Key 仍需在官方 Models 页面设置；未配置的目录服务商首次应用覆盖后才创建配置，本插件不单独录入密钥。

better-model-provider README · better-model-provider：Sparse, non-destructive per-model overrides on official-catalog routes — including reasoning-effort levels and their wire spellings — without replacing the catalog.

**Custom models: edit declarations. Official models: edit overrides. Provider configuration remains official.**

[中文](README.zh.md)

better-model-provider README · Why：The official Models page edits a model's input types and token capacities, but it does so by rewriting that route's whole `models` array: one field touched, and every other model on the route stops following the catalog — and sparse `modelOverrides` becomes illegal there. It also has no control for per-model reasoning effort.

better-model-provider README · Why：This page is the other seam. On an official-catalog route it writes only the difference for the model you touched — including `reasoningEfforts` levels and their wire spellings — and leaves the rest of the catalog following upstream. On your own declared routes it edits the declarations directly.

better-model-provider README · Install：The npm package ships ready-built, so this path never builds locally. Alternates: `github:sanshanya/better-model-provider#master` (CI republishes ready-built artifacts to the `master` branch on every green main push), or the default branch (`github:sanshanya/better-model-provider`), which builds from source and prints one pnpm `allowBuilds` key to add, then rerun `add`; a local `link:` install must `npm install && npm run build` first. Restart `dsh web`, and the Settings sidebar gains **Model capabilities**.
better-model-provider README · Install：dsh plugin --profile web rm better-model-provider

better-model-provider README · Use：1. Configure the provider and API key on the official **Models** page first — keys and route lifecycle are always managed there; this page does not repeat them.
2. Expand a model row and edit its capabilities:
   - **Reasoning effort**: pick **Custom**, check the levels you need; to offer "off" too, check `off` (its wire value may stay blank).
   - **Vision models**: check `image` under input modalities — otherwise sending an image to this model gets refused.
   - **Capacities**: K/M spelling reads best (`380K`, `1M`). Tap Apply and the change takes effect at once.
3. Official-catalog routes: tap **Manage official models** and edit. Every change here stores only the difference from the official default — everything else keeps following catalog updates; **Reset to official defaults** undoes all of one model's edits at once.
4. **Manage official providers (N)** unfolds installed-but-unconfigured routes: pick one, apply the first change, and the route comes into being (its API key still goes on the official page).

better-model-provider README · Use：The official Models page can also edit input types and capacities — but only by replacing a route's whole model list, which stops that route following the catalog and rules out overrides. Use this page when you want one model changed and the other thirty-seven still following it. Once a route's list *has* been replaced on the official page, this page edits that list like any declared route.
better-model-provider README · Use：Dedicated-adapter apps (built-in DeepSeek / OpenAI Codex) declare their capabilities on their own settings pages and never appear here.

better-model-provider README · Compatibility：| Harness line | Status |
|---|---|
| `dsh 0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest` / `next`) | verified end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.2.1-alpha.1` | verified end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.1.7-rc.2` | verified end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.1.5-rc.3` | verified end-to-end |
| `0.1.2-alpha.1` … `0.1.6-alpha.2` | **not verified** — admitted by the peer ranges, no lane has run on them |
| `0.1.0-rc.7` … `0.1.1-rc.2` | refused: no `connection.api` generation here any more |

better-model-provider README · Compatibility：Verified means both lanes on a real harness: integration boots a checkout and serves the plugin's client module, functional drives a real browser through a capability write and its revert. They are opt-in — `BMP_DSH_DIR=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:live` (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the functional lane) — and skip without it.

better-model-provider README · Compatibility：The peers are a single interval, `>=0.1.2-alpha.1 <0.3.0`: the floor keeps the retired `connection.api` generation out (the `0.1.0-rc.7` line stays refused), the ceiling admits the dsh `0.2` line. What actually rules on them at install time is dsh's admission gate — it reads prereleases with `includePrerelease: true`, and that is the path every install of this plugin takes; npm's own peer rule reads the tuple more strictly and disagrees on some versions, but it never governs that path. (Through 0.0.6 the range was enumerated per published line — a residue of npm's stricter reading; 0.0.7 converged it on dsh's semantics.) The nightly canary re-proves the `latest`, `next` and `alpha` channels, and a leg whose channel resolved but whose lane skipped fails the run instead of passing quietly; when a leg turns green again it closes that channel's accumulated red-tracking issues itself.

better-model-provider README · Compatibility：Field overlap: this page edits per-model `reasoningEfforts` (levels and their wire spellings) and sparse `modelOverrides` — the official Models page has no control for either. It also edits `input`, `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, which the official page edits natively, so those are a convenience here rather than a unique capability. Recovery: if the official page rewrote a route's whole model list while overrides saved here linger beside it, write validation rejects the route — the card offers **Remove leftover overrides**, one explicit click, never automatic.
